a.xlink:title: Owns the window, GPU resources and renderers; drives one frame of output.
Encapsulates the GLFW window and OpenGL context; the only place GLFW is touched.
Configures global OpenGL pipeline state (depth test, blending, viewport).
Contract for a camera providing view and projection matrices.
Perspective camera that orbits a target point (the 3D-mode camera).
Free-fly perspective camera: move with the keyboard, look with the mouse.
3D-mode projection wrapping the (toroidal) Zappy grid onto a real 3D torus.
Contract mapping grid coordinates to a point on the rendered world surface.
Translates window events into camera control, click detection and quit decisions.
